verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a pip-installable, open-source Python framework. It is driven programmatically through documented APIs: pipeline processors, the dev runner, Flows functions, and client SDKs with messaging and events. A documented official CLI also exists, and runtime probes confirm both the package import and the CLI work. missing for 10: an evidenced API reference for the core framework classes, a documented REST/management API for Pipecat Cloud (OpenAPI probes all returned 404), and independent corroboration of API completeness.
